name: SEEBLICK & GLUT
oneLiner: Wood-fire restaurant on the Wörthersee shore, Klagenfurt
audience: Lake-season couples and Carinthia food tourists seeking fire + view in one room — not hotel dining, not Stadt gastro
differentiator: Open hearth and floor-to-ceiling Lendkanal glass in a single dining room; twelve-dish menu, no schnitzel wallpaper

tokens.accentRule: ember accent only: live fire moments, prices, primary CTA, scroll progress — never decorative fill
